test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is half of its total surface area. If its height is 53 cm, then find its radius (in cm).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** is **half** of the **Total Surface Area (TSA)**, then **CSA = TSA/2**.

In a **cylinder**, this specific condition (CSA = TSA/2) always implies that the **radius (r)** is **equal** to the **height (h)**.

Given **Height (h) = 53 cm**.

∴ **Radius (r) = 53 cm**.

**∴ The correct answer is 53 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Height (h)** = 53 cm, **CSA** = 1/2 × **TSA**

**Formula Used:** **CSA** of cylinder = 2πrh; **TSA** of cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7d7e35a971f00f28a73a54ebaab40f1aef983c50078ffaf5488468a8d95bfad.png] 

According to the question:

⇒ 2πrh = 1/2 × [2πr(h + r)]

⇒ 2πrh = πr(h + r)

⇒ 2h = h + r

⇒ 2h − h = r

⇒ r = h

⇒ r = 53 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 53 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

The amount of space inside the cylinder is given by Volume = πr²h.

Surface Area Components

TSA = CSA + 2 × Base Area = 2πrh + 2πr². When r = h, TSA becomes 4πr² and CSA becomes 2πr².

Radius and Diameter

The **Diameter (d)** is always twice the **Radius (r)**, so d = 2r.</p
